name: DeskMoz
description_en:
DeskMoz supplies outsourced human customer-service operations rather than only a live-chat software license. It offers chat, phone, email, social and processing services with a manager, business-specific training, a dashboard and notifications. The chat tool is described as included with managed service; using an existing tool has separate conditions.

For an illustrative retail support pilot, approve answers and escalation limits, train the team, verify lead/ticket delivery and review completed transcripts with the manager. Current quotation-based pricing coexists with older plan names and conflicting contract, carry-forward and service-coverage statements. Those differences remain explicit here. No signup, agent training, chat, credential sharing, quote request, payment or export was performed.
description_zh:
DeskMoz提供外包真人客户服务运营，不只是在线聊天软件许可。它提供聊天、电话、邮件、社交及处理服务，配经理、业务培训、面板及通知。聊天工具描述为随托管服务提供，使用已有工具另有条件。

以假设零售支持试点为例，应批准答案及升级边界、培训团队、核对线索／工单投递，并与经理复核已完成记录。当前询价方案与旧套餐名并存，合同、余额结转和服务覆盖说明相互冲突，本稿保留这些差异。此次未注册、培训客服、聊天、分享凭据、请求报价、付款或导出。

core_features.explanation_en: Trained shared or dedicated CX staff handle the contracted service scope.
core_features.explanation_zh: 受训共享或专属CX人员处理约定服务范围。

core_features.explanation_en: Provide approved answers and instructions, then update knowledge as the business changes.
core_features.explanation_zh: 提供获准答案及说明，随业务变化更新知识。

core_features.explanation_en: Collected details and completed transcripts can be delivered through configured email/SMS recipients.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可将收集详情及已完成记录送达配置的邮件／短信收件人。

core_features.explanation_en: Coordinate feedback through an assigned manager and inspect counts/history in the dashboard.
core_features.explanation_zh: 通过指定经理协调反馈，并在面板检查数量／历史。

en: Pilot outsourced after-hours support with approved answers and accountable escalation.
Compare shared-volume staffing with a dedicated project for a defined workload.
zh: 以获准答案及明确升级负责人试点非营业时间外包支持。
针对明确负载比较按量共享值守与专属项目。
use_cases.basis: Editorial fit guidance, not verified staffing quality or customer outcomes.

Transcript access.en: FAQ says a customer cannot watch/intervene in an active agent chat and receives its transcript after completion. Real-time dashboard/notification claims do not establish live supervision rights.
Transcript access.zh: FAQ称客户不能观看／干预正在进行的客服聊天，完成后收到记录。实时面板／通知主张不能确定现场监督权利。

steps.zh: 明确渠道、服务时间、假日覆盖、用量单位、升级及当前报价条件。

steps.en: Supply approvedFAQs and exception owners;configure permittedtoolaccess andlead/transcriptrecipients.
steps.zh: 提供获准FAQ及例外负责人，配置允许的工具访问和线索／记录接收人。

steps.en: Use the pilot to inspect unknown answers,falsepromises,missinghandoffs,quotaandcompletedtranscripts.
steps.zh: 以试点核查未知答案、错误承诺、遗漏交接、额度及完成记录。

items.name: Existing third-party chat tool
items.scope: Vendor says it can operate another tool;FAQ listsUSD49/monthextra. Obtaincurrentquoteandspecificoperatorpermissions.

items.en: Pricing says contract term depends on resources; older chat/FAQ pages say month-to-month with no contract. Confirm selected terms in writing.
items.zh: 价格页称合同期依资源而定，旧聊天／FAQ页称无合同按月，须书面确认所选条件。

items.en: FAQ says unused quota does not roll over;2023terms permit carry-forward unless downgraded. No single entitlement established.
items.zh: FAQ称未用额度不结转，2023条款允许结转但降档清零，未确定统一权益。

items.en: 24/7marketing has holiday/emergency exclusions in terms, which list99%minimumratherthandisplayed99.7/99.9%claims.
items.zh: 24／7营销在条款有假日／紧急排除，条款最低99%，不同于展示99.7／99.9%主张。

pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 当前价格需询价，10天试点无设置费且无需卡。可选按量共享或专属项目，超额度可升级或另付。旧FAQ其他聊天工具每月49美元，不确定为当前通用费。合同／结转／取消冲突已保留。

faq.question_en: Is the chat software an independently free product?
faq.question_zh: 聊天软件是独立免费产品吗？
faq.answer_en: The read pages describe it as included with the managed service. The ten-day no-card pilot is not proof of sustained free agent service or standalone software rights.
faq.answer_zh: 所读页面称随托管服务包含，10天无需卡试点不能证明持续免费客服或独立软件权利。

faq.question_zh: 未使用聊天额度会结转吗？
faq.answer_en: Unresolved. FAQ says no; the2023terms say yes unless the plan is downgraded. Obtain the chosen quote and governing terms before budgeting.
faq.answer_zh: 尚不明确。FAQ称不结转，2023条款称可结转但降档除外。预算前应取得所选报价及适用条款。

official_check.scope: Public vendor documentation reviewed; no account execution, purchase, owner identity, independent review or publication approval.

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent reliability, usability or customer-outcome verification.
English and Chinese are paired drafts. Chinese text does not establish Chinese UI support.
All alternative relationships remain unreviewed. Public-web retrieval may use cached content; prices are dated observations.

sections.title_en: Evaluate the people and process, alongside the widget
sections.title_zh: 连同组件一起评估人员及流程
sections.en:
DeskMoz’s current homepage offers human CX outsourcing across calls, chat, email, social and back-office processing. The managed-chat page describes shared agents, while current pricing distinguishes shared volume-based work from dedicated project-based work. The buyer is selecting an operating service with training and oversight, not merely purchasing a dashboard or autonomous bot.

For an illustrative retail inquiry, define which returns, delivery questions and lead criteria staff may handle, and who approves an exception. The provider’s claimed CSAT, response times, client counts and outcomes are not independent measurements in this profile. A dedicated manager is a coordination role, not proof that every agent is dedicated exclusively to one business.
sections.zh:
DeskMoz当前首页提供电话、聊天、邮件、社交及后台处理的真人CX外包。托管聊天页描述共享客服，当前价格区分按量共享与按项目专属工作。购买者选择的是带培训和监督的运营服务，不只是面板或自主机器人。

以假设零售咨询为例，须确定哪些退货、配送问题及线索标准可由人员处理，谁批准例外。服务商CSAT、响应时间、客户数及结果不是本稿独立测量。专属经理是协调角色，不证明每位客服只服务一家企业。

sections.title_en: Approve knowledge and exception handling before launch
sections.title_zh: 上线前批准知识及例外处理
sections.en:
The onboarding guide asks customers to supply FAQs, instructions and website content, optionally with vendor assistance to prepare a draft for approval. Training and deployment are advertised within24–48hours. The FAQ measures the ten-day pilot from when agents go live, whereas the homepage summarizes signup as starting the pilot. Confirm the actual start and scope rather than losing evaluation time to setup.

The buyer can use the supplied widget or arrange access to an existing chat tool. Published requests to email credentials should not be copied into an operating procedure without determining appropriate operator access. Define permissions and approved changes with the service owner. Test an unknown question: FAQ describes asking the business or collecting the visitor’s contact for follow-up. That is a documented escalation path, not a guarantee that an agent never supplies an incorrect answer.
sections.zh:
入门指南要求客户提供FAQ、说明及网站内容，也可由厂商帮助起草后批准。培训及部署宣传24—48小时内完成。FAQ从客服上线算10天试点，首页却概括为注册开始，须确认真实起点和范围，避免设置占用评估时间。

购买者可用附带组件，或安排访问现有聊天工具。公开资料中邮件发送凭据的要求，不应在未确定适当操作员访问前照搬为流程。应与服务负责人明确权限及获准变更。需测试未知问题：FAQ描述询问企业或采集访客联系方式供后续跟进。这是文档升级路径，不保证客服永不提供错误答案。

sections.title_en: Inspect completed handoffs and the limits of supervision
sections.title_zh: 核查已完成交接及监督边界
sections.en:
Onboarding describes configurable lead/support email and SMS destinations and transcript recipients. Counts and history are available in the dashboard. A representative test should follow one qualified lead and one support issue to the right recipient with its full context, then verify the business actually owns the next response. A notification arriving is not the same as a lead being accepted or an issue resolved.

The FAQ says transcripts cannot be edited and arrive after completion; it also says customers cannot watch or intervene while agents are chatting. Therefore current real-time dashboard language should not be expanded into live co-supervision rights. Review a mistaken commitment and delayed/missing handoff with the manager during the pilot. Transcript immutability, delivery reliability and dashboard access controls remain vendor claims rather than exercised tests.
sections.zh:
入门说明可配置线索／支持邮件、短信及聊天记录接收人，面板可看数量和历史。代表性测试应追踪一条合格线索及一个支持问题，确认全部上下文送达正确接收人，且企业实际负责下一回复。通知到达不等于接受线索或问题解决。

FAQ称记录不可编辑且完成后送达，并称客户不能在客服聊天期间观看或介入。因此当前实时面板措辞不能扩展成现场共同监督权。试点中应与经理复核错误承诺及延迟／遗漏交接。记录不可变、投递可靠及面板权限仍属厂商主张，而非已运行测试。

sections.title_en: Reconcile coverage promises with excluded dates
sections.title_zh: 核对覆盖承诺及排除日期
sections.en:
The chat page markets24/7service but also says350+days. FAQ discusses eleven scheduled holidays; January2023terms exclude eleven holiday dates plus four reserved election/emergency days and specify99%minimum uptime. Other pages show99.7% or99.9% figures. These are not one consistent unconditional service commitment.

Confirm local time zones, each excluded date, backup staffing, first response, callback/escalation and compensation in the actual quote. The company’s claimed average29-second chat response and the older50–60second commitment are different measures. A business requiring continuous emergency coverage should not rely on a general24/7banner. No staffing roster, holiday operation, service-level calculation or recovery was tested.
sections.zh:
聊天页宣传24／7，也称350多天。FAQ讨论11个假日，2023年1月条款排除11个假日加4个选举／紧急保留日，并规定最低99%在线，其他页显示99.7%或99.9%。这些不是一致且无条件的服务承诺。

应在实际报价确认时区、每个排除日、备援、首答、回电／升级及补偿。厂商所称平均29秒，与旧50—60秒承诺是不同指标。需连续紧急覆盖的业务不能只依赖24／7横幅。本研究未测试排班、假日运营、SLA计算或恢复。

sections.title_en: Use a current quote to resolve material pricing conflicts
sections.title_zh: 用当前报价解决实质计费冲突
sections.en:
Current pricing provides no universal numeric base price: the service and volume determine a custom quote. It says no setup fee, no card for the ten-day pilot, manager notifications near quota and continued service with separately paid overage if not upgraded. A shared-agent historical27-cent/hour headline is not a complete project price. FAQ listsUSD49/month for operating another chat tool, but that fee needs current confirmation.

Material conflicts remain: current pricing says contract length depends on resource allocation, while chat/FAQ say month-to-month; FAQ rejects carry-forward, while2023terms allow it until a downgrade clears it. Cancellation also ranges from three working days in FAQ to resource detachment within24hours after outstanding bills clear in terms. Received payments are generally non-refundable. Agree which document and quote govern volume units, renewal, rollover, stopping and overage before paying.
sections.zh:
当前价格没有通用数字底价，按服务和用量定制报价。它称无设置费、10天试点无需卡、接近额度时经理通知，未升级时服务继续但另付超额。共享客服旧每小时27美分宣传不等于完整项目价，FAQ操作其他工具每月49美元也需当前确认。

实质冲突仍有：新价格页称合同期取决于资源，聊天／FAQ称按月；FAQ拒绝结转，2023条款则允许至降档清零。取消也从FAQ3个工作日，到条款结清账后24小时撤资源不等。已收款通常不退。支付前应确定适用文件及报价如何规定用量、续约、结转、停止及超额。

sections.title_en: Keep an independent record and note source quality
sections.title_zh: 保留独立记录并注明来源质量
sections.en:
The terms reserve proprietary service-component rights and describe deactivation or content loss on termination, with some information retained for legal/business purposes. They do not establish a complete export, restore, retention schedule or standalone open-source software license. Take a representative transcript/count export and agree deletion responsibilities before the service becomes the sole record of customer intake.

The publicly read FAQ includes obsolete plan references and unrelated gambling-promotion text; the onboarding page also contains unrelated advertising copy. Those are observed content-quality problems, not proof of their author, cause or a security incident. They reduce confidence in treating every published statement as current. This profile keeps the verified service identity, concrete workflow and conflicts, while leaving operational quality and selected contract terms unverified.
sections.zh:
条款保留服务组件专有权，并描述终止时停用或内容丢失，部分资料可因法律／业务目的保留。它未建立完整导出、恢复、留存表或独立开源软件许可。在成为唯一接待记录前，应测试代表性聊天／数量导出并确定删除责任。

所读公开FAQ含旧套餐及无关赌博推广文字，入门页也有无关广告。这是观察到的内容质量问题，不证明作者、成因或安全事故，降低了将所有公布陈述视为当前事实的把握。本稿保留核实的服务身份、具体流程及冲突，运营质量与所选合同仍未验证。
